text_blocks.snippet: For optimal protection against COVID-19, N95 or KN95 masks are recommended. These respirators offer the best filtration and fit, capturing at least 95% of airborne particles, including those carrying the virus.

list.title: N95 Masks:
list.snippet: These masks meet U.S. standards and are designed for a very close fit, providing a high level of protection when worn correctly.

list.title: KN95 Masks:
list.snippet: These masks meet international standards and are also effective at filtering particles. While some may not be up to quality, they generally offer good protection.

list.title: Proper Fit is Crucial:
list.snippet: Both N95s and KN95s require a proper fit to be effective. Ensure the mask fits snugly against your face, covering your nose and mouth, without any gaps.

list.title: Other Options:
list.snippet: While less effective than N95s and KN95s, surgical masks and well-fitting cloth masks can still offer some protection.

list.title: Important Considerations:
list.snippet: Avoid masks with exhalation valves, as they can allow respiratory aerosols carrying the virus to escape. Replace masks if they are damaged, wet, or soiled.
